_configurationInfo.text: Create and manage the monitored devices in the Device Manager tab on the left.

enabledNotifications.label: Enabled notifications
enabledNotifications.help: Select which status changes publish a message to info.message and, if enabled, send an ioBroker notification.

sendNotificationsViaNotify.label: Also send notifications via notify
sendNotificationsViaNotify.tooltip: The notification is received either by notify-manager or by Admin (bell). The info.message state is updated either way.

invalidResponseTimeSeconds.label: Response time for invalid sources and values (seconds)
invalidResponseTimeSeconds.help: Wait this long before an invalid source or value becomes active and generates a notification. Set to 0 for immediate activation.

summaryReminderEnabled.label: Enable recurring reminders
summaryReminderEnabled.help: At the configured times, summarize all monitored states that are currently not normal.

summaryReminderCron.label: Reminder schedule
summaryReminderCron.help: Choose when the current non-normal states should be summarized.

notificationCollectionEnabled.label: Pause notifications during a quiet period
notificationCollectionEnabled.help: Suppress individual notifications during the configured period. Optionally send one summary at the end.
